# Docker build & push

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-docs.mjs. Edit the manifest, then run `make docs`. -->

Build, tag, cache, and push a container image to any registry

```yaml
- uses: patrickisgreat/actions-toolkit/actions/docker-build-push@v1
```

## How it works

Build a container image and push it to GHCR, ECR, Artifact Registry, Docker Hub, or any
other registry — with sensible tags, layer caching, multi-arch, and optional provenance
attestation.

The registry is a parameter rather than five near-identical actions. Login is handled
here for GHCR and Docker Hub; for ECR and Artifact Registry you authenticate first with
`aws-auth` (ecr-login: true) or `gcp-auth` (docker-registries: ...) and this action
reuses that Docker credential.

Tagging is delegated to docker/metadata-action, so the defaults are the conventional
ones: `latest` on the default branch, `pr-N` on pull requests, the branch name on
branches, semver tags (`1.4.0`, `1.4`, `1`) on `v*` tags, and always an immutable
`sha-<short>`. Deploy actions should reference the digest output, not a mutable tag.

Caching uses GitHub Actions cache by default, which needs no extra infrastructure.
`cache: registry` is better for large images and cross-repo reuse.

## Inputs

| Input | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `registry` | no | `ghcr` | ghcr \| dockerhub \| ecr \| gar \| custom. Selects the login path and default host. |
| `registry-host` | no | `""` | Explicit registry host. Required for `ecr`/`gar`/`custom`, e.g. `123456789012.dkr.ecr.us-east-1.amazonaws.com` or `us-central1-docker.pkg.dev`. |
| `image` | no | `""` | Image repository path without the host, e.g. `myorg/api`. Defaults to this repo's name. |
| `context` | no | `.` | Build context path. |
| `file` | no | `""` | Path to the Dockerfile. |
| `target` | no | `""` | Dockerfile stage to build. |
| `platforms` | no | `linux/amd64` | Comma-separated build platforms, e.g. `linux/amd64,linux/arm64`. |
| `build-args` | no | `""` | Newline-separated `KEY=value` build arguments. Never put secrets here. |
| `secrets` | no | `""` | Newline-separated BuildKit secrets (`id=NAME,env=ENV_VAR`). Use this, not build-args. |
| `push` | no | `true` | true to push, false to build only (the right default for PR validation). |
| `tags` | no | `""` | Explicit newline-separated full tags. Overrides the generated tag set. |
| `extra-tags` | no | `""` | Additional docker/metadata-action `tags:` rules appended to the defaults. |
| `labels` | no | `""` | Additional newline-separated OCI labels. |
| `cache` | no | `gha` | gha \| registry \| none |
| `provenance` | no | `false` | true to attach SLSA build provenance to the pushed image. |
| `sbom` | no | `false` | true to generate and attach an SBOM. |
| `username` | no | `""` | Registry username. Defaults to `github.actor` for GHCR. |
| `password` | no | `""` | Registry password/token. `GITHUB_TOKEN` works for GHCR. |

## Outputs

| Output | Description |
|---|---|
| `image` | Fully qualified image reference without a tag (`host/repo`). |
| `tags` | Newline-separated list of tags that were built. |
| `version` | The primary version tag docker/metadata-action chose. |
| `digest` | Image digest (`sha256:…`). Deploy this, not a tag. |
| `image-digest-ref` | Immutable `host/repo@sha256:…` reference. The right thing to hand a deploy step. |
